title: Integrate European opcode 39 registry poses
changes: Publish the conditional opcode-39 registry pose model in e163-d162 and serve its newly owned index, sequence and decoded pixel bytes through typed runtime reads while retaining prior owners.
validation: Windows GNU test build 3ecrjj2q and Wine ga87pps5 passed dataset creation/reuse, preservation of 105 previous resources, all 91,712 typed source bytes with the original bytes altered, selected mixed boundaries and the prior sprite-42 root owner.

Wine ga87pps5 compared six controlled original reset cases through managed interpreter and generated instruction blocks against raw interpreter; all 12 full states and guest clocks matched. Generated blocks may fall back to interpretation.

Windows GNU production build 84354hhl and Wine vgo1cewu passed CLI create/reuse/verify for 107 files matching the tested e163 generation. Its 11-frame world-map window read zero opcode-39 pose bytes and did not change the generation.
limitations: Ordinary use, other producer domains, broader Wine regressions, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. The bounded CLI window is not evidence of global absence. No performance measurements.
